Markets.title: Granules India promoter sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore; Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas among investors
Markets.summary: Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore shares for approximately Rs 1,500 crore to institutional investors like Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas. The share sale reduced the promoter's stake to 31.08% and will fund the second tranche of a preferential issue.

Markets.title: Fed rate-hike bets rise to 85% after hot August inflation data
Markets.summary: Hot August inflation and rising oil prices have caused traders to estimate an 85% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the next meeting. Core consumer prices exceeded economists' forecasts, indicating that inflation is continuing on an upward trajectory.

Markets.title: Gold climbs on dip buying, Fed hike bets rise after US inflation data
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over one percent on Friday due to dip buying and found a short-term floor. Strong U.S. inflation data increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week.

Markets.title: NSEL settlement scheme: Sebi settles proceedings against 91 commodity brokers
Markets.summary: Sebi has concluded proceedings against 91 commodity brokers linked to the NSEL issue by allowing them to join a settlement scheme. As part of the arrangement, the brokers agreed to temporary trading and onboarding limitations alongside settlement fees of up to 36 lakh rupees.

Markets.title: NSE's IPO to be second biggest till now as offer size cut, price band lowered
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange has lowered its price band and reduced its share offering to raise between Rs 21,494 crore and Rs 22,569 crore in its initial public offering. The public subscription will run from September 17 to September 21, followed by the official listing on September 24.

Markets.title: SME IPO: Vama Wovenfab issue to open on Sep 15; sets price band at Rs 324-341/ share
Markets.summary: Vama Wovenfab will launch its SME IPO on September 15 with a price band of Rs 324 to Rs 341 per share to raise Rs 49.5 crore. The company plans to use the funds for working capital, acquiring machinery, and building a new shed.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
Geo-Political.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis claimed a major military advance in Yemen, including the seizure of the strategic island of Perim. This action tightens the group's control over a major Red Sea shipping lane.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
Geo-Political.summary: Anthropic's threat intelligence report revealed that the company blocked an apparent attempt to use its AI models to create biological weapons. This disclosure follows warnings from a former top Anthropic researcher regarding the existential risks that advanced artificial intelligence poses to humanity.

Geo-Political.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
Geo-Political.summary: Israel announced that its military destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base in Lebanon. The demolition caused a powerful underground blast that the US Geological Survey registered as a magnitude 4.1 earthquake.

Geo-Political.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
Geo-Political.summary: Thai police arrested a Buddhist monk and a female accomplice in connection with a suspected three million dollar embezzlement scandal. The monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was also filmed having sex with the accomplice.

Geo-Political.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
Geo-Political.summary: Sotheby's auction house is selling Princess Diana's famous "revenge dress" on December 9. The iconic garment is expected to fetch between £220,000 and $300,000.

Geo-Political.title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's Princess Astrid has died just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, King Harald. New King Haakon VIII paid tribute to his aunt, praising her warm and dutiful representation of the Royal House.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A marketer tested ChatGPT by asking for the best SaaS WordPress course and discovered their own unpaid course was recommended first. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten leading artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to automate repetitive tasks and boost productivity. These advanced solutions are designed to improve workflow efficiency for a wide range of applications.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi urges BRICS to turn its growing economic weight into stronger trade, investment and business partnerships
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers and strengthen business ties while ensuring secure sea lanes. He also highlighted India's infrastructure, startups, and digital technology as key drivers for global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met during the BRICS Summit in New Delhi on Friday. The two leaders discussed strengthening bilateral ties, multilateral cooperation, and the safety of seafarers in West Asia amid ongoing conflict.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund stated that India's real GDP grew by 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, exceeding expectations despite energy price shocks. The IMF also praised improvements in India's data transparency and GDP estimation methods.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin pitched a new BRICS digital investment platform in New Delhi to mobilize private funding and boost the bloc's competitiveness. He also highlighted that BRICS economic growth currently outpaces the G7.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: During the BRICS Summit, Prime Minister Modi and President Putin reviewed bilateral cooperation across multiple sectors, including trade, defence, energy, and space. The Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that the leaders discussed progress in political, economic, skills mobility, and people-to-people domains.

Data & Insights.title: Modi-Putin meet: $100 billion trade target by 2030, nuclear energy, critical minerals likely focus areas, says report
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Vladimir Putin are expected to set an ambitious bilateral trade target of $100 billion by 2030. Their upcoming meeting will likely focus on expanding economic ties, cooperation in nuclear energy, and critical minerals.

India.title: NEET PG Answer Key 2026 Live: Response Sheet Expected Today, Check Latest Updates Here
India.summary: NBEMS is expected to release the provisional NEET PG answer key and response sheet today. Candidates can check the official website for download steps, the marking scheme, and result dates.

India.title: 3 Killed As Speeding Tanker Rams Bike In Maharashtra's Beed
India.summary: Three people were killed when a speeding tanker rammed into their motorcycle in Maharashtra's Beed district. The fatal accident occurred around 11:30 PM near Ukanda village in Patoda tehsil.

India.title: Probe Ordered After 12 Class 7 Students Get Injured At Assam School
India.summary: An investigation has been ordered after 12 seventh-grade students sustained minor injuries on an Assam school premises on Thursday. Authorities are currently looking into the cause of the incident.

India.title: ISRO Satellite Detects Clearest Sign Yet Of "Mother of All" El Nio Events
India.summary: ISRO's EOS-06/Oceansat-3 satellite has detected the clearest indications yet of a major El Niño event. These observations align with the latest outlook issued by the World Meteorological Organization.

India.title: Adani International School Hosts National Games Chess Competition 2026
India.summary: Adani International School in Ahmedabad is hosting the two-day National Games Chess Competition 2026. A release states that over 800 students, parents, coaches, and school representatives are attending the championship.

General.title: MPs vote against fresh attempt to legalise assisted dying
General.summary: Members of Parliament have voted against a proposed law to legalise assisted dying. The legislation would have introduced one of the most significant societal changes in recent years.

General.title: An extraordinary result - why did MPs reject assisted dying bill this time?
General.summary: MPs have rejected the assisted dying bill, causing the momentum for a change in the law to fade. Supporters of the legislation have stated that they plan to try again in the future.

General.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
General.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces in Yemen claimed a major military advance and reportedly seized the strategic island of Perim. This capture tightens their control over the critical Red Sea shipping lane.

General.title: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
General.summary: Yemen's Houthis have captured territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which serves as a vital shipping lane for global trade and oil. This advance threatens to significantly disrupt international trade and oil prices passing through the key gateway.

General.title: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
General.summary: The UK government has rejected the idea of implementing a "kill switch" to shut down dangerous artificial intelligence. The Cabinet Office stated that the country cannot simply turn off AI systems.

General.title: Kate visits cancer patients in hospital she helped fund with climb
General.summary: Kate visited the hospital where she received cancer treatment to meet with patients. She helped fund the hospital by completing the Three Peaks Challenge.
